registration.statement: A molecular vibrational frequency is derived from a complete retained molecule, mode and symmetry carrier as the exact positive count of finite recurrences divided by a positive observation-interval count. A conventional reciprocal-centimeter inscription is a held unit translation applied only after that ratio exists. All 2,009 displayed NIST mode identities seal before 1,984 positive measurements and 25 structural measurement absences open; theoretical frequencies, ratios and fitted scale factors are excluded.
registration.title: Exact molecular vibrational recurrence-frequency law
